item.title: The Five Minute Read
item.description: The Five Minute Read highlights things to do, places to go and people to know in the Greater Lowell area. Have news to share? Send it to news@lowellsun.com. Submissions must be received at least one week in advance to be considered for publication. Submitted photographs should be at least 300 KB in JPG format.

item.title: Fitchburg survives surge by Patriots
item.description: FITCHBURG — One always wants to close out the season strong, especially a senior playing their last interscholastic contest. Behind 12 points and nine rebounds out of senior stalwart Mila Xiong, as well as strong games by its freshman dynamic duo, Fitchburg withstood a third quarter to remember for visiting North Middlesex Regional and went on a run of its own in the final frame of the 2025-26 campaign as the Red Raiders closed the season with a 54-36 victory over the Patriots at the Doug Grutch
